query: EV DC-DC converters United States import tariffs

statements.text: Entering 2026, the United States continues to enforce elevated import duties on power supplies under HTS 8504.40 from key manufacturing regions.

Imports from China remain heavily penalized at 45%, while Taiwan and Malaysia sit at 19%, the Philippines at 20%, and Japan at 15%. These are no longer temporary or proposed numbers. They are the baseline rates buyers and engineers must plan around moving forward.
A $100 power supply imported from China lands at $145 after tariffs. Taiwan and Malaysia units land at $119. Philippine units reach $120. Japanese supplies land at $115.
